systemArchitectures.name: Commercial Continuous Supercritical CO2 Static-Mixer Micro-Encapsulation Skid
systemArchitectures.classification: Industrial Sanitary Dense-Phase Fluid Encapsulation Skid (3-A Sanitary Standards 60-01 & 61-01 / ASME BPVC Section VIII Div 1 & 2 / FDA 21 CFR § 184.1240 GRAS / EHEDG Class I Aseptic)
systemArchitectures.technology: Continuous Supercritical CO2 In-Line Dosing (100–320 bar, 35–65°C), High-Shear Sulzer SMX+ Static Mixer Contactor, and Heated Coaxial Decompression Expansion Nozzle
systemArchitectures.metallurgy: Solid Forged AISI 316L Stainless Steel Flow Manifold (Ra ≤ 0.38 µm electropolished) with Grade 5 Titanium Static Mixer Inserts and Kalrez 6230 Sanitary High-Pressure Seals
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: Dual ASME UV-Stamped Rupture Discs (380 bar), Dynamic Joule-Thomson Anti-Choke Heating Jacket, Overpressure Auto-Bleed Loops, and Automated CIP/SIP Sterilization Cycles
systemArchitectures.description: Flagship industrial continuous supercritical CO2 static-mixer micro-encapsulation skid. Dissolves dense-phase scCO2 into biopolymer carrier shells and bioactive core feeds under laminar/turbulent micro-vortices, producing solvent-free, highly monodisperse sub-micron core-shell particles with >97% encapsulation efficiency and zero thermal degradation of sensitive bioactives.

systemArchitectures.technology: Low-Shear Helical Static Mixer Array with Precise Sub-Critical / Supercritical Phase Transition Control and Sterile Micro-Atomization Chamber
systemArchitectures.metallurgy: Electropolished Hastelloy C-22 Product Wetted Path with Gold-Plated Metallic O-Rings and Borosilicate Sight Glasses
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: Aseptic Closed-Loop CO2 Recirculation Condenser, Automated HEPA-Filtered Expansion Enclosure, and Overpressure Differential Burst Sensors
systemArchitectures.description: Specialized pharmaceutical and infant formula unit designed for live microbial therapeutics (Lactobacillus, Bifidobacterium) and delicate therapeutic enzymes. Operates at ultra-mild temperatures (35–38°C) to prevent cellular membrane rupture while ensuring complete enteric gastro-resistance.

systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: Explosion-Proof ATEX Electrical Drives, Volatile Terpene Scrubber Recirculator, and Inert N2 Purge Safeguard
systemArchitectures.description: High-throughput continuous encapsulation plant engineered for heat-sensitive volatile terpenes (limonene, myrcene, pinene), citrus oils, and astaxanthin, preventing oxidative polymerization and locking in fresh aroma profiles with 100% natural shell biopolymers.

systemArchitectures.description: High-precision analytical development skid for food engineering universities and R&D centers studying supercritical fluid solubility, static mixer shear dissipation, micro-emulsion droplet breakup, and microcapsule shell wall cross-linking.

coreMatrices.name: Live Probiotic Suspension (Lactobacillus rhamnosus GG / Bifidobacterium animalis, 1.2e11 CFU/g)
coreMatrices.shearSensitivity: Moderate (Requires laminar micro-mixing, max shear < 50,000 s^-1)
coreMatrices.description: High-density probiotic concentrate containing active lactic acid bacteria. Highly vulnerable to standard thermal spray drying (>75°C) and gastric acid (pH 1.8), requiring gentle, solvent-free dense-phase encapsulation to protect cell wall integrity.

coreMatrices.name: Lipophilic Fat-Soluble Vitamins (Cholecalciferol D3 & Menaquinone-7 K2 in MCT Carrier)
coreMatrices.shearSensitivity: Low (Robust under turbulent shear, prone to UV/photo-oxidation)
coreMatrices.description: High-potency hydrophobic vitamin solution dissolved in pharmaceutical-grade medium-chain triglycerides. Requires dense-phase supercritical dissolution to achieve sub-micron micellar dispersion for superior human intestinal bioavailability.

coreMatrices.name: Cold-Water Marine Omega-3 (DHA/EPA Ethyl Esters) with 5% Natural Astaxanthin Antioxidant
coreMatrices.shearSensitivity: Low to Moderate (Extremely sensitive to dissolved O2 and trace peroxides)
coreMatrices.description: Ultra-pure marine lipid extract rich in docosahexaenoic acid (DHA) and eicosapentaenoic acid (EPA). The scCO2 atmosphere provides 100% anaerobic oxygen-free processing, preventing fishy rancidity and peroxide formation.

coreMatrices.name: Standardized Curcuminoid Extract & Citrus Limonene Botanical Terpene Complex
coreMatrices.shearSensitivity: Low (Volatile evaporation and crystalline precipitation hazard)
coreMatrices.description: Therapeutic botanical extract with high crystallization propensity and intense aroma volatiles. Dense-phase scCO2 fluidization maintains curcumin in an amorphous, highly bioavailable state inside the lipid-protein shell matrix.

coreMatrices.name: Uncertified Industrial Synthetic Carrier with Trace Toluene Residues (Toxic Non-Food Hazard)
coreMatrices.description: CRITICAL HAZARD: Non-food grade chemical slurry containing banned petrochemically derived aromatic hydrocarbons (toluene, xylenes) violating FDA 21 CFR § 170.3 and USP <467> Class 1 solvent toxicity limits.

shellCarriers.name: Cross-Linked Native Whey Protein Isolate (WPI 90) + Low-Viscosity Sodium Alginate
shellCarriers.solubilityInScCO2: Low (Acts as anti-solvent precipitation matrix in RESS/PGSS)
shellCarriers.entericProtectionIndex: High (Forms dense gastro-resistant ionic coacervate at pH < 2.5)
shellCarriers.description: Synergistic dual-polymer shell. The protein forms an immediate outer barrier upon supercritical CO2 decompression, while alginate creates a calcium-responsive enteric mesh that resists stomach acid and dissolves rapidly in the small intestine.

shellCarriers.name: Enriched Non-GMO Sunflower Phosphatidylcholine + High-Purity MCT Lipid Shell
shellCarriers.solubilityInScCO2: High (Plasticized into low-viscosity liquid under 120+ bar scCO2)
shellCarriers.entericProtectionIndex: Moderate (Micellar lipid digestion and lymph absorption)
shellCarriers.description: Ideal for lipophilic vitamins and astaxanthin. In the static mixer, dense CO2 saturates the lipid phase, lowering melting point and viscosity, allowing instantaneous formation of solid sub-micron lipid nanocapsules (SLNs) upon expansion.

shellCarriers.name: Food-Grade Dewaxed Bleached Shellac + Corn Zein Biopolymer Matrix
shellCarriers.carrierType: Hydrophobic Plant & Natural Resin Enteric Shell
shellCarriers.solubilityInScCO2: Moderate (CO2-expanded solution with food-grade ethanol co-solvent)
shellCarriers.entericProtectionIndex: Superior (Zero dissolution at pH 1.2–2.0; rapid dissolution at pH > 6.5)
shellCarriers.description: Premium enteric coating delivering maximum protection against simulated gastric juice (pH 1.8), delivering 98%+ payload intact into the duodenum for targeted sustained release.

shellCarriers.name: Agglomerated Tapioca Maltodextrin (DE 10) + Acacia Senegal Gum Arabic
shellCarriers.solubilityInScCO2: Low (Rapid spray-solidification carrier for beverage powders)
shellCarriers.entericProtectionIndex: Immediate Dissolution (Designed for instant cold-water dispersion)
shellCarriers.description: Designed for instant beverage fortification. Yields completely free-flowing, non-hygroscopic micro-granules that dissolve instantaneously in cold water without surface oil separation or turbidity.

shellCarriers.name: Unrefined Technical Paraffin Wax with Polycyclic Hydrocarbon Contaminants (Toxic Hazard)
shellCarriers.entericProtectionIndex: NON-COMPLIANT: Indigestible mineral wax with carcinogenic PAH risks
shellCarriers.cleanLabelStatus: STRICTLY ILLEGAL: Violates FDA 21 CFR § 172 food additive regulations
shellCarriers.description: SEVERE CONTAMINATION: Industrial petroleum wax lacking food-grade clearance, leaching toxic polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAH) and mineral oil saturated hydrocarbons (MOSH/MOAH) into the food matrix.

staticMixerConfigurations.name: Sulzer SMX Plus Multi-Element High-Shear Mixing Core (18 Cross-Bar Elements)
staticMixerConfigurations.mixerType: High-Intensity Intermeshing Cross-Bar Geometric Static Mixer
staticMixerConfigurations.description: Industry gold standard for dense-phase liquid-supercritical fluid contactors. The intermeshing X-grid structure continuously divides, stretches, and folds the fluid lamellae, reducing striation thickness to <0.15 µm within milliseconds for homogeneous core dispersion.

staticMixerConfigurations.name: Kenics KM Helical Sanitary Element Array (24 Alternating 180° Left/Right Helices)
staticMixerConfigurations.mixerType: Sanitary Low-Shear Helical Element Static Mixer
staticMixerConfigurations.flowRegime: Laminar Helical Radial Splitting & Reorientation (Re 450 to 1,800)
staticMixerConfigurations.description: Designed for shear-sensitive live probiotics and fragile peptide chains. Induces smooth boundary-layer transition and alternating rotational vortices, minimizing hydrodynamic cell lysis while ensuring 98%+ supercritical CO2 gas saturation.

staticMixerConfigurations.name: Hybrid Multi-Orifice Impinging Jet Core + Downstream SMX Polishing Manifold
staticMixerConfigurations.description: Delivers maximum kinetic energy dissipation for sub-micron nano-encapsulation (d32 < 200 nm). Opposing high-pressure streams collide at the mixer inlet, followed by static mixer homogenization to achieve ultra-narrow particle size distribution.

staticMixerConfigurations.name: Unbaffled Smooth Pipe Flow Section (Zero Mixing Elements - Severe Macro-Phase Separation)
staticMixerConfigurations.flowRegime: NON-COMPLIANT: Stratified two-phase annular flow with zero emulsion formation
staticMixerConfigurations.description: CRITICAL PROCESS FAILURE: An unbaffled straight conduit lacking static mixer elements. Dense-phase scCO2 channels along the upper pipe wall while un-emulsified core and shell liquids separate into distinct phases, resulting in catastrophic 0% encapsulation.

expansionNozzleGeometries.name: Coaxial Induction-Heated Decompression Micro-Nozzle (120 µm Laser-Drilled Sapphire Orifice)
expansionNozzleGeometries.nozzleHeatingMethod: PID Controlled High-Frequency Induction Collar (+55°C Anti-Freeze Surface)
expansionNozzleGeometries.jouleThomsonProtection: 100% Anti-Choking Active Thermal Compensation (Prevents dry ice formation)
expansionNozzleGeometries.description: High-precision sapphire nozzle tip with coaxial jacket heating. Counteracts intense Joule-Thomson cooling during instantaneous expansion from 250 bar to 1 bar, preventing dry ice ice-plug choking and ensuring uniform supersonic spray atomization.

expansionNozzleGeometries.name: Laval Convergent-Divergent Supersonic Decompression Nozzle (Mach 1.4 Gas Jet)
expansionNozzleGeometries.nozzleHeatingMethod: External Band Resistance Heater with Internal Thermocouple Feedback
expansionNozzleGeometries.jouleThomsonProtection: Supersonic Kinetic Gas Heating + Preheated Wall Protection
expansionNozzleGeometries.description: Aerodynamically contoured de Laval nozzle geometry. Expands the gas-saturated solution into a supersonic spray cone, utilizing aerodynamic shock waves to atomize micro-droplets into monodisperse dry powders without secondary agglomeration.

expansionNozzleGeometries.name: Unheated Plain Capillary Tube (Severe Dry Ice Plugging & Explosive Pressure Surge Hazard)
expansionNozzleGeometries.jouleThomsonProtection: NON-COMPLIANT: Severe Joule-Thomson freezing (< -45°C), creating solid CO2 ice plugs that trigger immediate high-pressure upstream surges over 350 bar.
expansionNozzleGeometries.description: DANGEROUS CONFIGURATION: Lack of nozzle heating causes massive temperature drop due to Joule-Thomson expansion. Solid carbon dioxide dry ice clogs the capillary tip, stopping flow and provoking catastrophic overpressure hazard.

technicalStandards.title: Direct Food Substances Affirmed as Generally Recognized as Safe (GRAS): Carbon Dioxide
technicalStandards.requirement: Classifies food-grade high-purity carbon dioxide (purity ≥ 99.95%, moisture ≤ 20 ppm, total hydrocarbons ≤ 20 ppm) as Generally Recognized as Safe (GRAS) for direct food contact and extraction/micro-encapsulation processing.

technicalStandards.title: Residual Solvents in Pharmaceutical Products & Dietary Supplements
technicalStandards.requirement: Supercritical CO2 processing operates as a Class 3 or Non-Solvent technology, producing microcapsules with strictly 0.0 ppm residual organic volatile impurities (VOCs), eliminating carcinogenic solvent testing required for hexane/acetone/chloroform.

technicalStandards.title: Rules for Construction of High-Pressure Containment Vessels & Supercritical Fluid Chambers
technicalStandards.requirement: Mandates strict design margins, cyclic thermal/pressure fatigue analysis, Charpy impact toughness testing, and dual ASME UV-stamped safety pressure relief valves / rupture discs rated for operating pressures up to 350 bar.

technicalStandards.title: Sanitary Standards for High-Pressure Pumps, Homogenizers, and In-Line Constriction Devices
technicalStandards.requirement: Requires electropolished AISI 316L/Hastelloy wetted surfaces (surface roughness Ra ≤ 0.38 µm), crevice-free sanitary tri-clamp or high-pressure autogenous seals, FDA-compliant elastomeric seals (Kalrez/Viton), and validated Clean-In-Place (CIP) drainability.

technicalStandards.title: Hygienic Equipment Design for Closed High-Pressure Food and Beverage Processing Systems
technicalStandards.requirement: Governs the complete elimination of fluid dead legs, sanitary static mixer element cleaning, in-line steam sterilization (SIP at 121°C), and bacterial tight sealing between high-pressure process fluid and atmospheric environment.
